result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but a few elements look broken or inconsistent: the top-right profile/avatar button renders as an empty gray circle with only a notification dot (no icon or image), the favorite (heart) buttons use inconsistent backgrounds between cards, the 'Fastest near you' thumbnails have mismatched image treatments, and the search placeholder text is low-contrast.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right header appears empty: a plain light-gray circle containing only a small red notification dot, with no avatar image, user initials, or icon. It reads as a failed image load or missing glyph rather than an intentional control.
issues.suggestion: Render a fallback avatar (user photo, initials, or a person/account icon) inside the circle, and position the red notification badge on the circle's edge so the control is recognizable and tappable.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart is a bare white outline with no backing shape, while on the pizza card below it sits inside a dark translucent circle. The bare heart also has weak contrast against lighter parts of the image.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same translucent dark circular background (with consistent size and padding) to all heart buttons so they remain legible over any image and look uniform.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the first thumbnail (Green Bowl Poké) uses a flat light-gray background while the other thumbnails use dark blurred photo backgrounds, making the row look visually mismatched.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image treatment (same background/blur/overlay style) across all carousel thumbnails, or supply a proper photo for the first card.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (or lighten the field less) to reach at least ~4.5:1 contrast against the input background.
